en.q: How do I get a NIF in Portugal as a non-resident?
en.a: Online, through a legal representative on the Finanças e-balcão, or in person at a tax office. No tax representative is needed to get it. Once the home is yours: 15 days to appoint one or join electronic notices.
en.source: Sources: Tax and Customs Authority, NIF leaflet; General Tax Law, art. 19
